We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule reproduces the carbonyl-ene reaction (intramolecular). The given molecule is a complex with a ketone? Let's examine SMILES: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

Interpretation: There's an alkene CH2= C attached to aromatic ring (c1... phenyl). That carbon also attached to chiral carbon 9 which is part of a cyclobutane? Actually [C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])... So a five-membered ring? Atoms 9-10-11-12-13 form a cyclopentane, with OH on carbon 13, and carbon 15 attached to carbon 13? Actually [C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18] means carbon 13 attached to OH and to carbon 15 which is CF3 group. So the molecule is a cyclopentane with CF3 substituent and OH, attached to alkene that is attached to phenyl.

The carbonyl-ene reaction would involve a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene within same molecule to form a new C-C bond and hydroxyl. But our molecule currently has an OH, not a carbonyl. So retrosynthetic step would break the C-O bond to form a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene? Actually forward reaction: carbonyl-ene: carbonyl (C=O) + alkene -> new C-C bond, new C-O (hydroxyl) at allylic position, and shift of double bond. So retrosynthesis: break C-O bond to get carbonyl (ketone) and alkene. So we need a template that does that transformation.

We need to search for template that breaks ketone and C=C to form C-O and C-C? The search didn't return any. Maybe need to search with functional_groups_broken: ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"] and formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"] gave empty. Could be that template ID is not found due to limited database. Maybe we need to use apply_template to see which template works? Could search for templates that involve carbonyl-ene reaction. Maybe use functional_groups_broken: ["ketones"], formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"], bonds_order_changed: ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"]? Already tried.

Maybe we need to use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with candidate template IDs known for carbonyl-ene. But we don't know IDs.

Alternative: Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with no criteria, just limit maybe 20, then iterate to find one that matches our molecule. Let's get list of templates (maybe many). Use limit 20.
